lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਇਹੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: khojat khojat ihai beechaario sarab sukhaa har naamaa ||
lines.translation: Searching and searching, I have come to this realization: all peace and bliss are in the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਲੇਖੁ ਮਥਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak tis bhaio paraapat jaa kai lekh mathaamaa ||4||11||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, he alone receives it, upon whose forehead such destiny is inscribed. ||4||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin raam ke gun kaheeai ||
lines.translation: Night and day, utter the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਸਿਧਿ ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal padaarath sarab sookh sidh man baa(n)chhat phal laheeai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You shall obtain all wealth, all pleasures and successes, and the fruits of your mind's desires. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਸਿਮਰਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavahu sa(n)t praan sukhadaate simarah prabh abinaasee ||
lines.translation: Come, O Saints, let us meditate in remembrance on God; He is the Eternal, Imperishable Giver of Peace and Praanaa, the Breath of Life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਾਥਹ ਨਾਥੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਘਟ ਵਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: anaathah naath deen dukh bha(n)jan poor rahio ghat vaasee ||1||
lines.translation: Master of the masterless, Destroyer of the pains of the meek and the poor; He is All-pervading and permeating, abiding in all hearts. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸੁਨਾਵਤ ਸਰਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaavat sunat sunaavat saradhaa har ras pee vadabhaage ||
lines.translation: The very fortunate ones drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, singing, reciting and listening to the Lord's Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਜਾਗੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kal kales mite sabh tan te raam naam liv jaage ||2||
lines.translation: All their sufferings and struggles are wiped away from their bodies; they remain lovingly awake and aware in the Name of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਤਜਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh jhooth taj ni(n)daa har simaran ba(n)dhan toote ||
lines.translation: So abandon your sexual desire, greed, falsehood and slander; meditating in remembrance on the Lord, you shall be released from bondage.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਅਹੰ ਅੰਧ ਮਮਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: moh magan aha(n) a(n)dh mamataa gur kirapaa te chhoote ||3||
lines.translation: The intoxication of loving attachments, egotism and blind possessiveness are eradicated by Guru's Grace. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too samarath paarabraham suaamee kar kirapaa jan teraa ||
lines.translation: You are All-Powerful, O Supreme Lord God and Master; please be Merciful to Your humble servant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: poor rahio sarab mahi thaakur naanak so prabh neraa ||4||12||
lines.translation: My Lord and Master is All-pervading and prevailing everywhere; O Nanak, God is Near. ||4||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਚਰਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: balihaaree guradev charan ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Feet of the Divine Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਰਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai sa(n)g paarabraham dhiaaeeai upades hamaaree gat karan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I meditate with Him on the Supreme Lord God; His Teachings have emancipated me. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਰੋਗ ਭੈ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਜੋ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: dookh rog bhai sagal binaase jo aavai har sa(n)t saran ||
lines.translation: All pains, diseases and fears are erased, for one who comes to the Sanctuary of the Lord's Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਜਪੈ ਅਵਰਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵੈ ਵਡ ਸਮਰਥ ਤਾਰਨ ਤਰਨ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aap japai avarah naam japaavai vad samarath taaran taran ||1||
lines.translation: He Himself chants, and inspires others to chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord. He is Utterly All-Powerful; He carries us across to the other side. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਉਤਾਰੈ ਸਹਸਾ ਊਣੇ ਕਉ ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa ko ma(n)tr utaarai sahasaa oone kau subhar bharan ||
lines.translation: His Mantra drives out cynicism, and totally fills the empty one.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਤ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਗਰਭ ਪਰਨ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har daasan kee aagiaa maanat te naahee phun garabh paran ||2||
lines.translation: Those who obey the Order of the Lord's slaves, do not enter into the womb of reincarnation ever again. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਕਮਾਵਤ ਗਾਵਤ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੇ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagatan kee tahal kamaavat gaavat dukh kaate taa ke janam maran ||
lines.translation: Whoever works for the Lord's devotees and sings His Praises - his pains of birth and death are taken away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਜਰ ਜਰਨ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau bhaio kripaal beethulaa tin har har ajar jaran ||3||
lines.translation: Those unto whom my Beloved becomes Merciful, endure the Unendurable Ecstasy of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਹਿ ਅਘਾਨੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਤ ਬਰਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: har rasahi aghaane sahaj samaane mukh te naahee jaat baran ||
lines.translation: Those who are satisfied by the Sublime Essence of the Lord, merge intuitively into the Lord; no mouth can describe their state.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤੋਖੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਉਧਰਨ ॥੪॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur prasaad naanak sa(n)tokhe naam prabhoo jap jap udharan ||4||13||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, they are content; chanting and meditating on God's Name, they are saved. ||4||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਾਇਓ ਰੀ ਮੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaaio ree mai gun nidh ma(n)gal gaaio ||
lines.translation: I sing, O I sing the Songs of Joy of my Lord, the Treasure of Virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਲੇ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਭਲੇ ਦਿਨ ਅਉਸਰ ਜਉ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ਰੀਝਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhale sa(n)jog bhale din ausar jau gopaal reejhaaio ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Fortunate is the time, fortunate is the day and the moment, when I become pleasing to the Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹ ਚਰਨ ਮੋਰਲੋ ਮਾਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tah charan moralo maathaa ||
lines.translation: I touch my forehead to the Feet of the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਸੰਤ ਧਰੇ ਹਾਥਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hamare masatak sa(n)t dhare haathaa ||1||
lines.translation: The Saints have placed their hands on my forehead. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਹ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਮੋਰਲੋ ਮਨੂਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhah ma(n)tr moralo manooaa ||
lines.translation: My mind is filled with the Mantra of the Holy Saints,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਗਤੁ ਹੋਏ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਨੀਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: taa te gat hoe trai guneeaa ||2||
lines.translation: and I have risen above the three qualities||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਹ ਦਰਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਨੈਨ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagatah daras dekh nain ra(n)gaa ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of God's devotees, my eyes are filled with love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਤੂਟੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: lobh moh toote bhram sa(n)gaa ||3||
lines.translation: Greed and attachment are gone, along with doubt. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak sukh sahaj ana(n)daa ||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, I have found intuitive peace, poise and bliss.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਲੑਿ ਭੀਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੪॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: kholhi bheet mile paramaana(n)daa ||4||14||
lines.translation: Tearing down the wall, I have met the Lord, the Embodiment of Supreme Bliss. ||4||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ghar 2 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl, Second House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੈਸੇ ਕਹਉ ਮੋਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਬੇਦਨਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaise kahau mohi jee bedanaaee ||
lines.translation: How can I express the pain of my soul?

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਪਿਆਸ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਨੋਹਰ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਰਹੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਉਮਕਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: darasan piaas pri preet manohar man na rahai bahu bidh umakaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I am so thirsty for the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of my Enticing and Lovely Beloved. My mind cannot survive - it yearns for Him in so many ways. ||1||Pause||
